rules.arrays: numeric ndarray/list cells use complete tolist values; display strings also retained
rules.bbox: [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax] computed from all four exact projected corners
rules.centroid: strict 2D POINT; catalog numeric equality within 1e-12 degrees
rules.centroid_grid_check: EPSG3857 midpoint inverse projection vs stated centroid, atol 1e-6 degrees; not a geographic join tolerance
rules.date: strict ISO date or ISO datetime; original preserved, first calendar date compared
rules.event_aoi: unsigned decimal integer; source leading zeros retained in source_row
rules.fractions: finite percent in [0,100]; catalog agreement absolute tolerance 1e-10
rules.grid: exact EPSG:3857, shape[224,224], GDAL[x0,10,0,y0,0,-10]; no rounding/snap/rotation repair
rules.partition: exact train/validation/test strings; no alias mapping
rules.source_id: integer decimal digits; id=ks_{source_id:05d}; exact full expected set
rules.source_times: finite source time_start/time_end preserved; never promoted to acquisition dates
